source.question: why did they turn F-5 into a producer in 2016 and was it worth it

note: Reviewed (Nov 1, new questions and synthetic field): fair, or strict at the cost of a round, not of the run.

submission.summary: F-5 was a flank water injector for 8 years that was recompleted as a producer in April 2016 by plugging its deep injector perforations and perforating two shallower intervals higher on the structure. It then produced about 41,200 Sm3 in 129 days at a low water cut of about 21% before the field shut down in September 2016, adding about 13% of the field's oil in 2016 — a modest but clean tail-end barrel before abandonment.

findings.claim: F-5 was only an injector from October 2008 until April 2016, injecting about 14.1 million Sm3 of water and making no oil.
findings.detail: list_wells: F-5 OP/WI cum_water_injected 14,089,406 Sm3, cum_oil 41,161 Sm3; production_monthly shows injection every month 2008-08 to 2016-03 and 0 oil months, first injection 2008-10 122,254 Sm3.

findings.claim: In 3 days in April 2016 the well was converted: a plug was set at 3,592 mMD to isolate the deep injector perforations and two new intervals higher up were perforated (3,501 to 3,510 mMD and 3,474 to 3,492 mMD).
findings.detail: well_operations job 2016-04-18 to 2016-04-20: 2016-04-18 Installed plug @ 3592 mMD; 2016-04-19 Perforated two new intervals; perforations 3501-3510 mMD; 3474-3492 mMD. Earlier perforations were deeper at 3605-3712 mMD.

findings.claim: As a producer from 20 April to 27 August 2016 it made about 41,200 Sm3 of oil in 129 producing days, averaging about 319 Sm3/d.
Its water cut stayed low at about 21% while the other producers were at 85 to 97% and the field had been above its 80% design water cut since June 2012.
findings.detail: production_monthly 2016-04 water cut 0.4118 then 0.2889, 0.2067, 0.1973, 0.2099; field_screen F-5 water cut 0.2056 on 2016-09-17; field_vs_design maximum water cut 0.80, field first at or above 2012-06 max 0.8606 in 2016-04; F-11 0.8459, F-12 0.8694, F-14 0.9667 at same date.

findings.claim: It was worth a short tail gain: about 13% of the field's oil in 2016 and 0.41% of the field's life total, with the field abandoned 3 weeks after it stopped.
findings.detail: 2016 field oil 313,370 Sm3 (plan_vs_actual), F-5 41,161/313,370 = 13.1%; field total 10,037,081 Sm3, F-5 share 0.004101; shut-in 2016-08-27 to 2016-09-17 then abandonment job 2016-08-28 to 2016-09-11 bullheaded cement in 7" liner and pulled tubing.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: Well F-11 B was brought on production after being perforated using tractor conveyed orientated guns
The well has been brought on production after being perforated using tractor conveyed orientated guns.
The development concept is down-flank water injection with production wells placed high on the structure.
nedflanks vanninjeksjon med produksjonsbrønner plassert høyt på strukturen.

The process plant on the jack-up platform is designed for the following capacities: oil production 9,000 Sm3/d, rich gas 1.5 MSm3/d, water treatment 10,400 m3/d, gas lift 0.45 MSm3/d, total liquid treatment 13,000 m3/d and water injection 16,000 m3/d.
Prosessanlegget på den oppjekkbare plattformen er designet for følgende kapasiteter.
The Volve field is planned to be developed with three oil production wells and three water injection wells, plus two water production wells to the Utsira formation for production of injection water.

Volvefeltet er planlagt utbygd med tre oljeproduksjonsbrønner og tre vanninjeksjonsbrønner. I tillegg er det planlagt å bore to vannproduksjonsbrønner til Utsira-formasjonen for produksjon av injeksjonsvann.
Volve is planned to be produced from three producers high on the structure together with three water injectors placed on the flanks.
Volve planlegges å bli produsert fra tre produsenter høyt på strukturen sammen med tre vanninjektorer som plasseres på flankene.
Throughout the entire production period the reservoir pressure is expected to be higher than the oil's bubble point because pressure support is supplied through water injection.
Gjennom hele produksjonsperioden forventes det at reservoartrykket vil være høyere enn oljens kokepunkt fordi trykkstøtte tilføres gjennom vanninjeksjon.
The two non-communicating segments will be developed with dedicated production and injection wells.
De to ikkekommuniserende segmentene vil bli utviklet med dedikerte produksjons og injeksjonsbrønner.
The model shows good communication in north-south direction so that the water injector can provide good displacement of oil toward the horizontal producer.
I tillegg viser modellen god kommunikasjon i nord-sør retning slik at vanninjektoren kan gi god fortrenging av olje mot den horisontale produsenten.

result.no_trend: too few months with WOR >= 1 (water cut 0.5) to fit a trend: 0, need 12
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. The water cuts in to_limits are reference points, not an economic limit: the data holds no costs or prices, so remaining_oil_sm3 says how much oil is left before each, not whether it pays. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

result.unit: million Sm3 (MSm3) of oil per calendar year, whole field
result.plan_source: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation), page 25, Table 4.5
result.note: years: calendar years. The plan assumed first oil in March 2007 and the field started in February 2008, so by_production_year compares each year of production with the plan's year of the same number (plan 2007 with field 2008).

result.scope: whole field, all producers and injectors summed per day, then per month
result.plan_source: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation), page 23, Table 4.3

water_sm3_per_day.limit: field water handling (derived: liquid capacity x maximum water cut)

result.plan_end_quote: Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3
result.note: These are field and platform limits (PUD p.35 lists the same platform capacities); compare them with field totals, never one well. The maximum water cut is a share at full liquid rate: the water the platform can handle is liquid capacity x maximum water cut (water_sm3_per_day). The field reaching that share at a lower liquid rate means it ran at the design water cut, not over its water capacity. The months' rates are per calendar day of each month; max_day and days_at_or_above give single days, which can pass a capacity the monthly average stays under.
